nodes.label: rag-learn Project
nodes.rationale: Side-by-side RAG retrieval comparison demo answering the same question with Chroma and Milvus Lite in parallel, streaming DeepSeek tokens through a Gradio 5 UI.

nodes.label: Chroma Retriever
nodes.rationale: ChromaRetriever.ensure_indexed short-circuits when the store is non-empty; lazy chromadb import inside __init__ to avoid model-download cost on unrelated tests.

nodes.label: Milvus Lite Retriever
nodes.rationale: ensure_indexed runs load_collection defensively in a spawn subprocess (_safe_load_collection) because macOS ARM milvus-lite 2.6+ SIGSEGVs at the C layer; pymilvus 2.6+ search() no longer auto-loads collections, so without it every restart hits 'Collection in state released'.

nodes.label: Gradio UI
nodes.rationale: launch() sets GRADIO_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=False because the Gradio 5.50 analytics daemon's concurrent os.urandom calls SIGSEGV the interpreter on macOS ARM alongside milvus-lite gRPC fork handlers; UI streaming is batched via _drain_to_chatbot, not per-token.

nodes.label: config.load_config / ConfigError
nodes.rationale: config._repo_root() walks up from config.py looking for pyproject.toml so the same code works from nested worktrees.

nodes.label: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY env var
nodes.rationale: Mandatory; load_config() raises ConfigError and the app refuses to start without it.
